description: Lists refunds for a specific Stripe charge, ordered by creation time descending. Results are paginated and can be used to track refund history and audit transactions.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing refunds for a specific charge with pagination support.

charge.description: The ID of the charge to list refunds for. This ID typically starts with 'ch_'.
charge.title: Charge

ending_before.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

expand.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.
expand.title: Expand

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

starting_after.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.
starting_after.title: Starting After

RefundData.description: Detailed model representing a single refund object from Stripe.

amount.description: Amount refunded, in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD, yen for JPY).
amount.title: Amount

balance_transaction.description: ID of the balance transaction reflecting this refund's impact on the account balance. When expanded, this is a full Balance Transaction object.
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

charge.description: ID of the charge that was refunded. When expanded, this is a full Charge object.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Timestamp (in seconds since the Unix epoch) indicating when the refund object was created.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g., 'usd', 'eur') representing the currency of the refund.
currency.title: Currency

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Available on non-card refunds only.
description.title: Description

destination_details.description: Details about the refund destination, containing payment method-specific transaction information.
destination_details.title: Destination Details

failure_balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction that reverses the initial balance transaction after a refund failure. When expanded, this is a full Balance Transaction object.
failure_balance_transaction.title: Failure Balance Transaction

failure_reason.description: Reason for refund failure. Possible values include 'lost_or_stolen_card', 'expired_or_canceled_card', 'charge_for_pending_refund_disputed', 'insufficient_funds', 'declined', 'merchant_request', 'unknown'.
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund object. (e.g., 're_1KvLBN2eZvKYlo2Cl2u0nZLJ')
id.title: Id

instructions_email.description: Email address where refund instructions were sent for payment methods lacking native refund support.
instructions_email.title: Instructions Email

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs that you can attach to a refund object. Useful for storing additional, structured information about the refund.
metadata.title: Metadata

next_action.description: Contains information about what actions are required when the refund status is 'requires_action'.
next_action.title: Next Action

object.description: String representing the object's type. For refund objects, the value is 'refund'.
object.title: Object

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent for the charge that was refunded. When expanded, this is a full PaymentIntent object.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

pending_reason.description: Reason why the refund remains pending. Possible values: 'processing', 'insufficient_funds', 'charge_pending'.
pending_reason.title: Pending Reason

receipt_number.description: Receipt number for this refund, displayable to the customer.
receipt_number.title: Receipt Number

source_transfer_reversal.description: Transfer reversal object from the source account.
source_transfer_reversal.title: Source Transfer Reversal

status.description: The current status of the refund. Possible values: 'pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled', 'requires_action'.
status.title: Status

transfer_reversal.description: ID of the transfer reversal if the refund is associated with a reversed transfer.
transfer_reversal.title: Transfer Reversal
